summary: Iteration 15 — Retested the frontend fix for Contact Invite entry point in RecordDrawer.jsx. RESULT: The render fix at line 910 works — Platform access panel (data-testid=contact-actions) and 'Invite to Platform' button (data-testid=contact-invite) DO render inside the contact drawer for platform.admin@grc.demo on /contacts. HOWEVER, clicking the button fails with a 404 because the invite POST hits '/api/contacts/undefined/invite'. Root cause: the ID_FIELD map at RecordDrawer.jsx:15-18 is missing the `contacts: "contact_id"` entry, so `record[idField]` resolves to `record[undefined]` → undefined. This blocks the Copy-link toast + clipboard flow entirely (toast.error 'Not Found' fires instead). Test 1 (render): PASS. Test 2 (invite POST + Copy link toast): FAIL. Test 3 (clipboard write of /reset-password?token= URL + confirmation toast): FAIL (blocked by 2). Also observed two 422s on drawer open (likely /comments or /related fetch using undefined entity_id — same idField root cause).

action_items: RecordDrawer.jsx: add `contacts: "contact_id"` to the ID_FIELD map (line 15-18). One-line fix that unblocks the invite flow AND fixes the 422 comments/related fetches on the contact drawer.

After fix: re-run the same Playwright flow — button click should POST /api/contacts/<contact_id>/invite successfully, a Sonner toast with a 'Copy link' action button (duration ~10s) should appear, clicking Copy link should call navigator.clipboard.writeText with a URL containing '/reset-password?token=', and a confirmation toast ('Invite link copied to clipboard') should render.
critical_code_review_comments: The ID_FIELD map should be exhaustive across every `kind` supported by RecordDrawer. Consider deriving `idField` as `${singular}_id` (singular already computed nearby) so a missing map entry doesn't silently produce `record[undefined]` and cascade into 404/422 across invite/comments/related/evidence.

renderContactActions() correctly guards on isPlatformAdmin and hasEmail — but consider also disabling the button when `record[idField]` is falsy (defensive) so a mis-mapped kind fails visibly instead of firing a 404 POST.
The two 422 errors from /comments and /related on contact drawer open are the same root cause and would resolve automatically once ID_FIELD.contacts is set.

rca of the issue: Bug: Contact invite POST 404s. Reproduction: login platform.admin@grc.demo → /contacts → click 'UI Invite Target' → panel + Invite button render (fix from iteration 14 works) → click Invite to Platform → confirm dialog auto-accepted → POST fires to '/api/contacts/undefined/invite' (captured via page.on('response')) → 404. Root cause: RecordDrawer.jsx line 15-18 `const ID_FIELD = { reviews, findings, risks, policies, vendors, assets, tasks, exceptions }` — no 'contacts' key. Therefore idField = ID_FIELD['contacts'] = undefined, and record[undefined] = undefined at line 305. Mitigation: add `contacts: "contact_id"` to the ID_FIELD map. Same fix also eliminates the two 422 errors from /comments and /related that fire on contact drawer open.
